However, Li Hua hasn't watched the game adaptation yet, but she plans to do so soon. Li Hua's plan includes watching "The Last of Us" to experience the emotional depth and gripping storyline, which she believes will be similar to her experience with "Chernobyl." Emily's recommendation seems to have piqued Li Hua's curiosity about the game, and she intends to enjoy its adaptation of the popular video game.
